description: Author estimates on LIVE's Elo-like scale, based on the statements and solution requirements, not a paper-position formula. LIVE values take precedence when later published. Shared 2026 AMC 10/12 problems receive identical estimates. The 2026 AMC 10A estimates were reviewed problem by problem on 2026-11-11 after the owner sat the paper: #25 came down sharply and #8, #16, #18, #20 and #21 moved. On 2026-11-13 every 2026 AMC 10A/12A estimate was rebuilt as the usual LIVE rating at its question number over the last ten papers of that contest, plus a judged adjustment stated in its reason; HMMT problems with published results are rated from them by tools/hmmt-results.py.
